user_message.de: Diese Anfrage konnte nicht verarbeitet werden.
user_message.en: That request could not be processed.

PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED.message: A password change is outstanding, so no other route is served for this login.

user_message.de: Bitte legen Sie ein neues Passwort fest, bevor Sie fortfahren.
user_message.en: Please set a new password before continuing.

PASSWORD_NOT_AVAILABLE.message: This account signs in through a provider, so it has no password here to change.

user_message.de: Für dieses Konto sind keine Passwortänderungen möglich.
user_message.en: Password changes are not available for this account.

PAYMENT_METHOD_MISSING.message: A payment method is required before this can proceed.

user_message.de: Eine Zahlungsmethode ist erforderlich.
user_message.en: A payment method is required.

PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_FOUND.message: No payment method answers that id for this organization.

user_message.de: Diese Zahlungsmethode gibt es nicht.
user_message.en: That payment method does not exist.

PERMISSION_DENIED.message: The credential is valid but does not grant access to this.

user_message.de: Sie haben keinen Zugriff darauf.
user_message.en: You do not have access to this.

PERSON_FROZEN.message: This person has been offboarded. The record is kept frozen — name and email included — so that everything they did still reads correctly.

user_message.de: Der Datensatz dieser Person ist eingefroren und kann nicht geändert werden.
user_message.en: This person's record is frozen and cannot be changed.

PLAN_ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED.message: The plan's included units for this cycle are spent ({used} of {limit}) and no prepaid balance remains. Buy units, or wait for the next billing cycle.

user_message.de: Alle {limit} in diesem Abrechnungszeitraum enthaltenen Einheiten sind verbraucht.
user_message.en: All {limit} units included this cycle have been used.

PLAN_HAS_SUBSCRIBERS.message: Organizations are still on this plan. Move them to another one first.

user_message.de: Auf diesem Tarif befinden sich noch Kunden. Wechseln Sie sie zuerst.
user_message.en: Clients are still on this plan. Move them to another plan first.

PLAN_INCLUDED_RATE_ABOVE_PREPAID.message: Included units cannot cost more per unit than prepaid units.

user_message.de: Enthaltene Einheiten dürfen pro Einheit nicht mehr kosten als Prepaid-Einheiten.
user_message.en: Included units cannot cost more per unit than prepaid units.

PLAN_NOT_AVAILABLE.message: That plan is not available for selection.

user_message.de: Dieser Tarif ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: That plan is not available.

PLAN_PREPAID_RATE_ABOVE_OVERAGE.message: The prepaid rate cannot be above the overage rate.

user_message.de: Der Prepaid-Preis darf nicht über dem Überverbrauchspreis liegen.
user_message.en: The prepaid rate cannot be above the overage rate.

PLAN_SWITCH_ALREADY_SCHEDULED.message: A switch to that plan version is already scheduled. Cancel it first.

user_message.de: Ein Wechsel zu dieser Tarifversion ist bereits geplant.
user_message.en: A switch to that plan version is already scheduled.

PLAN_SWITCH_CUSTOM_BILLING_FLIP.message: That target would change how this organization is billed, which a switch may not do.

user_message.de: Dieser Tarif würde die Art der Abrechnung dieses Kunden ändern.
user_message.en: That plan would change how this client is billed.

PLAN_SWITCH_NOOP.message: That plan version is already the active one, so there is nothing to switch.

user_message.de: Diese Tarifversion ist bereits aktiv.
user_message.en: That plan version is already active.

PLAN_SWITCH_PERIOD_SEALED.message: That date falls in a cycle that is already settled, and settled cycles stay so.

user_message.de: Dieses Datum liegt in einem bereits abgerechneten Zeitraum.
user_message.en: That date falls in an already-settled period.

PLAN_SWITCH_WHEN_INVALID.message: That is not a valid moment for a plan switch.

user_message.de: Das ist kein gültiger Zeitpunkt für einen Tarifwechsel.
user_message.en: That is not a valid moment for a plan switch.

PLAN_USAGE_LEVERS_CONFLICT.message: Usage billing is off for this plan, so every usage lever must be zero — a non-zero one would read as configuration that does nothing.

user_message.de: Verbrauchsparameter müssen null sein, solange die Verbrauchsabrechnung aus ist.
user_message.en: Usage levers must be zero while usage billing is off.

PLAN_VERSION_DATE_TAKEN.message: This plan already has a version starting at that moment.

user_message.de: Für diesen Tarif existiert bereits eine Version mit diesem Startzeitpunkt.
user_message.en: This plan already has a version starting then.

PLAN_VERSION_GAP.message: A plan must stay covered by a version at every moment, leaving no gap.

user_message.de: Ein Tarif muss mindestens eine Version behalten.
user_message.en: A plan must keep at least one version.

PLAN_VERSION_NOT_FOUND.message: No version of this plan answers that id.

user_message.de: Diese Tarifversion gibt es nicht.
user_message.en: That plan version does not exist.

PLAN_VERSION_WINDOW_INVERTED.message: A plan version cannot end before it starts.

user_message.de: Eine Tarifversion kann nicht enden, bevor sie beginnt.
user_message.en: A plan version cannot end before it starts.

PRECONDITION_UNMET.message: {endpoint} was called before {precondition} was satisfied, so it did nothing. The session is unaffected; satisfy it and call the action again.

user_message.de: Dafür liegt noch nichts vor.
user_message.en: There is nothing to do that with yet.

PRICING_IMMUTABLE.message: Pricing rows are never rewritten — usage already billed at this price depends on it. Add a row with a later validity window instead.

user_message.de: Preise können nach dem Anlegen nicht mehr geändert werden.
user_message.en: Pricing cannot be changed once created.

PRICING_WINDOW_INVERTED.message: A pricing window cannot end before it starts.

user_message.de: Ein Preiszeitraum kann nicht enden, bevor er beginnt.
user_message.en: A pricing window cannot end before it starts.

PROMPT_LANGUAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED.message: This version supports {languages}, so a prompt cannot be written for another.

user_message.de: Diese Version unterstützt {languages}.
user_message.en: This version supports {languages}.

PROVIDER_ADAPTER_INACTIVE.message: The adapter behind {config} is not active, so {provider} was skipped.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_ADAPTER_MISMATCH.message: The adapter behind {config} does not belong to {provider}. This is a catalogue inconsistency rather than a switch someone turned off.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_CONFIG_DEPRECATED.message: The adapter config {config} selected for {provider} is deprecated. The resolver redirects through a replacement before validating, so reaching this means the replacement chain is itself a dead end.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_CONFIG_INACTIVE.message: The adapter config {config} selected for {provider} is not active.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_CONFIG_NOT_ALLOWED.message: The adapter config {config} is linked to specific workflows, and this one is not among them, so it was not used for {provider}.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_CONFIG_PARAM_MISSING.message: The connector behind {config} does not supply every parameter that model requires, so {provider} could not be filled.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_CONFIG_RETIRED.message: The adapter config {config} selected for {provider} is deprecated and names no replacement, so there is nothing to fall through to.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_CONNECTOR_INACTIVE.message: The connector behind {config} is not active, so {provider} was skipped.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_CONNECTOR_KEY_MISSING.message: The connector behind {config} holds no API key, so nothing could authenticate at the vendor and {provider} was skipped.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_INACTIVE.message: The {provider} capability is switched off platform-wide.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_MODEL_INACTIVE.message: The catalogue model behind {config} is not active, so {provider} was skipped.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_MODEL_VENDOR_INACTIVE.message: The model vendor behind {config} is not active, so {provider} was skipped. This is the vendor that built the model, not the one serving it.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_SERVICE_VENDOR_INACTIVE.message: The service vendor behind {config} is not active, so {provider} was skipped. This is the vendor serving the API, not the one that built the model.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

PROVIDER_UNRESOLVED.message: No adapter config could be selected for {provider}: nothing is configured for it on the form, the workspace, the plan or the platform defaults.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

RANGE_INVALID.message: That range is not valid — the minimum is above the maximum.

user_message.de: Dieser Bereich ist nicht gültig.
user_message.en: That range is not valid.

REASON_REQUIRED.message: A reason is required: an adjustment without one is unexplained money.

user_message.de: Eine Begründung ist erforderlich.
user_message.en: A reason is required.

user_message.de: Die Registrierung ist derzeit geschlossen.
user_message.en: Registration is currently closed.

REPLACEMENT_NOT_FOUND.message: No model answers the id given as the replacement.

user_message.de: Dieses Ersatzmodell gibt es nicht.
user_message.en: That replacement model does not exist.

REPLACEMENT_REQUIRED.message: Deprecating this model requires naming the model that replaces it.

user_message.de: Ein Ersatzmodell ist erforderlich.
user_message.en: A replacement model is required.

REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.message: The request body is larger than this route will read. Send less in one call, or stream it where the endpoint supports that.

user_message.de: Das ist zu groß zum Senden.
user_message.en: That is too large to send.

SCOPE_STOP_REQUESTED.message: The {scope} scope was asked to stop, and its components are winding down.

user_message.de: Wird abgeschlossen.
user_message.en: Finishing up.

SECRET_KEY_INVALID.message: That secret key does not match the key it was presented with.

user_message.de: Diese Anwendung konnte sich nicht anmelden. Bitte wenden Sie sich an die Person, die sie eingerichtet hat.
user_message.en: This application could not sign in. Please contact whoever set it up.

SECRET_KEY_REQUIRED.message: This request needs the secret half of the key pair, not only the key id. Send it from your server — a secret key must never reach a browser.

user_message.de: Diese Anwendung ist nicht vollständig eingerichtet.
user_message.en: This application is not fully set up.

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.message: A dependency could not be reached. This is transient — a deploy, or a node moving the process — so the same request is worth retrying shortly.

user_message.de: Speechineer ist kurz nicht erreichbar. Bitte versuchen Sie es in Kürze erneut.
user_message.en: Speechineer is briefly unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

SIGNING_KEY_NOT_FOUND.message: No active signing key matches that token's key id. The key may have been archived, or the token was signed with a key from another workspace.

user_message.de: Diese Anwendung ist nicht vollständig eingerichtet.
user_message.en: This application is not fully set up.

SOURCE_VERSION_NOT_FOUND.message: The version named as the source does not exist.

user_message.de: Diese Ausgangsversion gibt es nicht.
user_message.en: That source version does not exist.

STOP_RECORDING_REQUESTED.message: Recording should stop. The service emits this when a stop condition is reached; a client sends the same event to ask for it.

user_message.de: Die Aufnahme wurde beendet.
user_message.en: Recording has stopped.

TARGET_NOT_PUBLISHED.message: The target version is not published.

user_message.de: Die Zielversion ist nicht veröffentlicht.
user_message.en: The target version is not published.

THROTTLED.message: Too many requests in the counted window. Back off and retry.

user_message.de: Zu viele Versuche. Bitte warten Sie einen Moment und versuchen Sie es erneut.
user_message.en: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

TRANSCRIPTION_DOWN.message: Transcription lost its connection and is reconnecting — attempt {retry_attempt} of {max_retries}, next in {retry_delay}s. Audio captured so far is kept.

user_message.de: Verbindung wird wiederhergestellt — bitte sprechen Sie in einem Moment weiter.
user_message.en: Reconnecting — please keep speaking in a moment.

TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED.message: Transcription stopped and could not be restarted within its retry budget, so the session ended. Audio already transcribed is kept; start a new session to continue.

user_message.de: Die Aufnahme wurde unerwartet beendet. Bitte starten Sie erneut.
user_message.en: The recording stopped unexpectedly. Please start again.

TRANSCRIPTION_SEND_FAILED.message: A chunk of audio could not be sent to transcription — attempt {retry_attempt} of {max_retries}, next in {retry_delay}s.

user_message.de: Verbindung wird wiederhergestellt — bitte sprechen Sie in einem Moment weiter.
user_message.en: Reconnecting — please keep speaking in a moment.

UNIT_LEDGER_IMMUTABLE.message: Ledger entries are append-only — the ledger is the money record. Post an adjustment instead of editing an entry.

user_message.de: Buchungen können nach dem Schreiben nicht mehr geändert werden.
user_message.en: Ledger entries cannot be changed once written.

UNIT_MAPPING_BACKDATED.message: A unit mapping may only take effect now or later. Back-dating one would re-price usage that has already been billed.

user_message.de: Einheitenzuordnungen können nicht rückdatiert werden.
user_message.en: Unit mappings cannot be back-dated.

UNIT_MAPPING_INCOMPLETE.message: At least one meter this session can produce has no unit mapping in effect, so that usage will be refused rather than recorded at a price nobody configured.

user_message.de: Ein Teil des Verbrauchs dieser Sitzung wird möglicherweise nicht erfasst.
user_message.en: Some usage from this session may not be recorded.

UNIT_MAPPING_MISSING.message: No unit mapping was in effect for that model and meter unit at the time of the session, so the usage cannot be priced and was refused rather than recorded as free.

user_message.de: Dieser Verbrauch konnte nicht bepreist werden.
user_message.en: That usage could not be priced.

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.message: This route does not read that content type. The body itself is fine — send it as one of the types the endpoint documents.

user_message.de: Diese Art von Datei wird hier nicht unterstützt.
user_message.en: That kind of file is not supported here.

UPSTREAM_INVALID.message: A dependency answered with something unusable, so nothing could be relayed. Retrying the same request will produce the same answer — quote the request id when reporting it.

user_message.de: Auf unserer Seite ist ein Fehler aufgetreten. Bitte versuchen Sie es später erneut.
user_message.en: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.

user_message.de: Der Verbrauch wurde erfasst.
user_message.en: Usage was recorded.

USAGE_RECORD_IMMUTABLE.message: Usage records are append-only — they are the evidence behind an invoice. Write a correcting entry instead of editing this one.

user_message.de: Verbrauchseinträge können nach dem Schreiben nicht mehr geändert werden.
user_message.en: Usage records cannot be changed once written.

VALIDATION_ERROR.message: The request could not be processed as sent. See the causes listed with it.

user_message.de: Einige der übermittelten Angaben wurden nicht akzeptiert.
user_message.en: Some of the details sent were not accepted.

WEBSOCKET_KIND_UNSUPPORTED.message: This workflow has no {kind} connection, so the one that was opened was closed. The session is unaffected — stop opening it.

user_message.de: Ein Teil dieser Funktion ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: Part of this feature is not available.

WORKFLOW_FEATURE_UNKNOWN.message: The workflow exists but is bound to a feature this release does not implement. Nothing in the request can fix it — it is a configuration gap on our side.

user_message.de: Dieser Workflow ist nicht verfügbar.
user_message.en: That workflow is not available.

WORKFLOW_KIND_NOT_FOUND.message: No workflow of that kind exists. Check the name against the ones your plan enables.

user_message.de: Diesen Workflow gibt es nicht.
user_message.en: That workflow does not exist.

WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND.message: No session answers that id. It was never created, or it has ended and been swept. Create a new session rather than retrying this one.

user_message.de: Diese Sitzung ist nicht mehr verfügbar.
user_message.en: That session is no longer available.

WORKFLOW_STANDALONE_MODE_UNSUPPORTED.message: That workflow cannot run with a configuration declared in code. Configure it in the portal and resolve it by form key instead.

user_message.de: Diese Anwendung ist nicht vollständig eingerichtet.
user_message.en: This application is not fully set up.

WORKSPACE_INACTIVE.message: That workspace is not active. A deactivated workspace can be switched back on in the portal; an archived one is final, and its sessions, keys and forms stay frozen with it.

user_message.de: Dieser Workspace ist nicht aktiv.
user_message.en: This workspace is not active.

WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND.message: No workspace answers that id for this organization.

user_message.de: Diesen Workspace gibt es nicht.
user_message.en: That workspace does not exist.

WORKSPACE_OWNER_REQUIRED.message: Only a workspace owner can do this.

user_message.de: Das können nur Besitzerinnen und Besitzer des Workspace tun.
user_message.en: Only a workspace owner can do this.

WORKSPACE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.message: The workspace has used {used} of its {limit} units for this {layer}. Raise the workspace's limit, or wait for the period to roll over.

user_message.de: Dieser Workspace hat alle {limit} Einheiten verbraucht.
user_message.en: This workspace has used all {limit} of its units.
